 STIPLULATION IN PLACE OF M.D. ABEL CO. AND JOE ABEL AND CINDY ABEL
              CROSS-EXAMINATION OF MR. JEFF WHITING

       Intervenors M.D. Abel Co., and Joe and Cindy Abel (the “Abels”) and Intervenors Jeff and

Ariana Whiting (the “Whitings”) stipulate as follows:

           1. The Abels (Party No. 440) timely designated Mr. Whiting (Party No. 464) for cross-
              examination.

           2. The Whitings stipulate that Mr. Whiting withdraws the following portions from his
              direct testimony filed on :

                  a. Page 7, lines 11 – 14 (“If the Commission determines … land substantially
                     less than Link H42”).

                  b. Page 27, lines 1 - 3 (“We further request … to our family and our land.”)

           3. The Abels agree to waive cross-examination of Mr. Jeff Whiting.

                                            Respectfully submitted,


                                            /s/ Adam M. Friedman
